title: An explicit ell-power annihilator of every uniformizer quotient
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite intermediate extension inside Qbar_ell, and pi an element of its integer ring generating the maximal ideal. For every n≥0, ell^(n+1) is zero in ULift(O_E/(pi)^(n+1)), the actual completedResidue coefficient of [def-sfb-diagonal-coefficient-diagrams].

source.place: paragraph (1), annihilator of an arbitrary positive uniformizer quotient

proof.text: The integer ell belongs to the maximal ideal, hence to (pi). Its (n+1)st power lies in (pi)^(n+1). Apply Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem and the injective ULift projection.

    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField l)
    (π : PadicAlgCl.integers l E)
    (hπ : Ideal.span {π} = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (PadicAlgCl.integers l E)) (n : ℕ) :
    ((l ^ (n + 1) : ℕ) : ULift.{u + 1} (completedResidue l E π n)) = 0
